name: images_expand
description: AI outpaint to `aspectRatio`: keeps the original and generates new surroundings, anchoring the subject automatically. Crop instead (no new pixels): `images_crop`. Ratios: 1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 21:9.

folderReference.description: From `folders_list`. Omit → the user's Personal project (refused if `disabled`). Does NOT persist: once the user names a target, pass it on EVERY later generation/edit call.

mode.description: Generation model. Default: ideogram, or classic when the account may not use ideogram.

prompt.description: Hint for what to generate in the new area, e.g. "sandy beach".
